## Change and reason

Describe one concrete problem and its minimal fix.

## Evidence

- [ ] Synthetic reproducer/regression included where appropriate
- [ ] Relevant targeted checks and serial aggregate passed on frozen inputs
- [ ] Evidence matches changed source/binary bytes; counts are not inflated
- [ ] No credentials, personal paths, real argv, raw logs/state or histories
- [ ] Safety boundaries and prior-art attribution remain accurate
- [ ] No host-OOM test, unrelated-process control or paid model inference

List commands and limitations. AI assistance does not replace understanding
or independent verification; see CONTRIBUTING.md.
